items.title: Interview #108 Spencer Insolia, Founding Managing Director, US, Duvo
items.summary: Spencer Insolia, Founding Managing Director (US) at Duvo, breaks down why so many enterprise AI agents stall in pilot: they are built on the process diagram from headquarters instead of how the work actually gets done. He explains why demos only show the happy path, how three people running the same process three different ways makes automation brittle, and why agent budgets overrun when agents burn tokens on exceptions nobody taught them. Spencer also dives into the money quietly leaking between big software systems, from freight invoices to trade deductions worth 2-5% of revenue, and why measuring AI by headcount cut is the wrong goal. Finally, he shares where a human must stay in the loop and whether retailers will get more value from AI on the shopping side or in the back office by 2027.
